Odin control

°C

Touch temporarily raises Odin's comfort band before wind and cold, and when a room lags. Your own schedule is written back afterwards, and Touch leaves it alone if you change it in Odin.

With Generic HTTP, Touch's control is set under System › Heat source › Control via HTTP.

Distribution per controller

—

Circulation pump and approximate split per manifold

House balance

Without balancing valves, the manifold with short, wide loops takes flow from the others. Touch therefore throttles the easy manifold so the house's most demanding loop still gets flow. V6 keeps its own split within each manifold. If Touch is gone for 15 min, V6 returns to its own balance.
